277:t_1:36.en:
$$勝平$$
「The $$ギャラクシー船団$$? Those are the guys we fought in the $$再世戦争$$!」

277:t_1:37.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Those guys... Are they up to some scheme again, I wonder...」

277:t_1:38.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「But not everyone we ran into was an enemy. ...Allow me to introduce someone.」

277:t_1:41.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Her name is $$シビル$$. She's a 《$$プロトデビルン$$》.」

277:t_1:42.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hold on a second! I heard about the $$プロトデビルン$$ from $$ミレーヌ$$ before, but...!」

277:t_1:43.en:
$$タケル$$
「Aren't they the enemy that fought the $$マクロス７船団$$!?」

277:t_1:45.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「After listening to $$バサラ$$'s song, the $$プロトデビルン$$ became able to regenerate $$スピリチア$$ on their own, so they no longer need to attack other living things.」

277:t_1:46.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「In short, they've become beings no different from us.」

277:t_1:47.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「We had been driven into a corner by a $$サイデリアル$$ attack, when $$ゲペルニッチ$$, the leader of the $$プロトデビルン$$, appeared to rescue us...」

277:t_1:48.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$シビル$$ ended up coming along as support for $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$.」

277:t_1:49.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「When $$バサラ$$ sings 'POWER TO THE DREAM', $$シビル$$ joins in, too.」

277:t_1:51.en:
$$ノノ$$
「If that's the case, you're more than welcome. Nice to meet you, $$シビル$$!」

277:t_1:54.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「It's okay, $$ワッ太$$. She's just happy.」

277:t_1:55.en:
$$アルト$$
「It took us a while to get used to it, too.」

277:t_1:56.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「...And in the middle of that fighting, we got caught in a $$時空震動|lc$$ and were transported to the same mysterious space you were thrown into.」

277:t_1:57.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「So the rest is pretty much the same.」

277:t_1:58.en:
$$甲児$$
「Still, to think the fundamental calamity and the $$サイデリアル$$ were connected...」

277:t_1:59.en:
$$アルト$$
「Yeah... That force may be their trump card.」

277:t_1:60.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「An enemy that damages even our hearts with overwhelming power...」

277:t_1:61.en:
$$アルト$$
「The terror when I laid eyes on that thing was on a different level from every enemy we've fought so far.」

277:t_1:62.en:
$$タケル$$
「Fear that can't be shaken off... Truly an enemy fundamental to humanity.」

277:t_1:63.en:
$$アルト$$
「But we'll do this... $n has overcome fear too and fought all the way to today, after all.」

277:t_1:64.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Come to think of it, how is he...?」

277:t_1:65.en:
$$甲児$$
「...He's still unconscious, even after we rejoined. I think it's because the $$血塗られた眼$$ appeared in that mysterious space.」

277:t_1:67.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$アルト$$... Isn't it about time $n woke up?」

277:t_1:68.en:
$$アルト$$
「We can't just leave him be. Let's go check on him.」

277:t_1:74.en:
$$ハサン$$
「He woke up a good while ago.」

277:t_1:75.en:
$n
「What's the matter, you guys? All of you together...」

277:t_1:76.en:
$$アルト$$
「What are you talking about! We came because we were worried about you!」

277:t_1:77.en:
$$アマタ$$
「It's true! We heard you suddenly collapsed...!」

277:t_1:78.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Was it the influence of the $$血塗られた眼$$ after all?」

277:t_1:81.en:
$n
「I don't know how that mysterious space and the black $$アンゲロイ$$... and the $$テンシ$$ I've been chasing... are connected...」

277:t_1:82.en:
$$アマタ$$
「If the $$血塗られた眼$$ still showed up, does that mean $$ガドライト#pilot$$ wasn't the enemy who took your family, $n...?」

277:t_1:83.en:
$n
「I half expected it... I can't say $$ガドライト#pilot$$ and the $$テンシ$$ are unrelated in my mind, but somewhere I always felt a gap between them.」

277:t_1:84.en:
$n
「Besides, the $$血塗られた眼$$ showed up at $$ラース・バビロン$$ too... There's surely some connection between the $$テンシ$$ and $$サイデリアル$$, but right now we have no way to pursue it...」

277:t_1:86.en:
$n
「Sorry for worrying you. But... I'm fine.」

277:t_1:88.en:
$n
「I've managed somehow up to now. It'll be the same from here on.」

277:t_1:90.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But in the fight in that space, I feel like I came to understand a little about your $$血塗られた眼$$, $n...」

277:t_1:91.en:
$$甲児$$
「Me too. ...So that's how you always fight.」

277:t_1:93.en:
$n
「But even I got through it somehow. If it's you guys, that thing will never crush you.」

277:t_1:94.en:
$$アルト$$
「Listen to you. Figures, from the first one to stop being the quiet type.」

277:t_1:96.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We gave $n such high-and-mighty advice, so now we have to pull it off ourselves.」

277:t_1:97.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Anyway, he says himself there's nothing to worry about, so he should be fine now.」

277:t_1:99.en:
$$ハサン$$
「That's fine, but shouldn't you say a word to Miss $$スズネ$$?」

277:t_1:102.en:
$n
「S-Sorry, Miss $$スズネ$$! I... didn't know you'd been watching over me...!」

277:t_1:103.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't worry about it. More importantly, take care of yourself.」

277:t_1:106.en:
$$アルト$$
「It's like the $$時獄戦役$$ all over again...」

277:t_1:107.en:
$$アマタ$$
「It's true that things have been rough ever since the assault on $$ラース・バビロン$$, but...」

277:t_1:108.en:
$n
「...But we now have a prospect of getting back to Earth.」

277:t_1:109.en:
$$アルト$$
「From Jupiter, a few Folds will get us back to Earth space.」

277:t_1:110.en:
$$甲児$$
「It's odd to say we owe it to being thrown to the galactic center, but we also got hold of information on the universe's collapse.」

277:t_1:111.en:
$$シン$$
「And on the $$サイデリアル$$ trump card too.」

277:t_1:112.en:
$n
「We return to Earth and pay the $$新地球皇国$$ back.」

277:t_1:113.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「And then we fight $$バアル$$.」

277:t_1:114.en:
$$甲児$$
「We've got plenty to do. We have no time to lose to despair or fear.」

277:t_1:116.en:
$n
(Wait for me, $$宗介$$... We'll be back on Earth soon.)

277:t_1:117.en:
$n
(I'm counting on you all being safe...)
